source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration
source.location: Fig S3 legend; Fig 2A; Results text

injury: transverse cuts just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.timing: dsRNA injected days 1-3, amputated day 8 or 14
intervention.description: Worms injected with Smed-H,K-ATPase dsRNA on days 1-3, then cut above and below the pharynx; pharynx fragments regenerated.

readout.method: morphological scoring of head and pharynx of regenerates

notes: Fig S3 legend: RNAi headless 4.2%, shrunken heads 91.6%, n=166 (counts converted: 7 and 152). Same arm as Fig 2A (shrunken 91.6%, n>=125) and Results text. Remaining ~4.2% not described. 'other' = headless regenerates (no head regenerated), which fit no head-shape category. 'altered_shape' = 'shrunken head' (proportionally tiny head).

source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration

injury: transverse cuts just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.description: Pharynx fragments of S. mediterranea treated with the H,K-ATPase inhibitor SCH-28080 in the bath during regeneration.

readout.method: morphological scoring of head and pharynx of regenerates

notes: Fig S3 legend: SCH-28080 headless 6.1%, shrunken heads 35.1%, n=131 (counts converted: 8 and 46). Remaining ~58.8% not described. Dose, timing and duration of SCH-28080 not stated in this paper (refers to Beane et al. 2011). 'other' = headless regenerates (no head regenerated). 'altered_shape' = 'shrunken heads'.
